title: Issuance
description: Global CAA checking and a local record of the CA's own ACME rate limits, applied to every certificate.

caaCheck.title: Check CAA records
caaCheck.description: Walk each name's CAA record set before ordering; fail fast when none authorizes the CA.

rateLimits.title: Rate limits
rateLimits.description: Local tracking of the CA's own ACME rate limits, enforced before an order is placed. Set a limit to 0 to disable it.

certsPerRegisteredDomainPerWeek.title: Certificates per registered domain per week
certsPerRegisteredDomainPerWeek.description: Counted per registered domain across every certificate. 0 disables the limit.

duplicateCertsPerWeek.title: Duplicate certificates per week
duplicateCertsPerWeek.description: Counted per exact set of names. 0 disables the limit.

failedValidationsPerHour.title: Failed validations per hour
failedValidationsPerHour.description: Counted per registered domain. 0 disables the limit.

newOrdersPer3Hours.title: New orders per 3 hours
newOrdersPer3Hours.description: Counted per CA account. 0 disables the limit.
